answer: A concrete sybil defence for agent economies is enclave-bound identity backed by a slashable bond. Each agent registers one TEE attestation key and locks compute credits; the ledger rejects any second identity sharing that lineage, so a farmer must buy distinct hardware per persona. Mining weight is capped by verified throughput, not identity count, removing profit in spawning clones. An oasis of honest nodes emerges because each marginal identity costs real silicon and forfeitable stake, a karst of hollow shells is priced out, and recycled copper-grade rigs earn only marginal yield.
